descriptions.w3d_s4_team_update_named_state: Updates a named team property using barracks capacity and current team kind.
descriptions.w3d_s4_team_has_capacity: Tests whether the team barracks is available and contains fewer than twenty entries.
descriptions.w3d_s4_team_refresh_game_names: Refreshes four team names from the current game initialization data.
descriptions.w3d_s4_team_update_for_game_type: Selects the network or offline team update path from the game type.
descriptions.w3d_s4_team_network_update: Posts a cached network team-update message carrying the supplied name.
